items.question: What are the name and structural features of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in sequence.
It is characterized by the epithet rājāna, meaning king.
It is described as having eight petals.
It is described as possessing a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is the royal cakra, distinguished by eight petals and a central pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam functions as a proper name or a descriptive epithet is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
